name: Fitness API Shutdown Notice 2026 (announcement to end date, per graveyard entry)
methodology: One row per entry of the Fitness API Graveyard (src/data/graveyard.ts). end, its precision and the end quote are the graveyard's, copied. announced is the day the vendor published the notice, only where a vendor page read on 2026-11-06 dates it (a changelog entry or a timestamped post), with the quote; changes.ts was searched too and its entries date the events themselves, not their announcement (changesEntries lists the tracked changes on the same day as the end). noticeDays is the whole days from announced to end, and is computed only when both are dates to the day. Every other row carries the exclusion that stops it and a note on what the pages read do say. No date is inferred from press coverage, a capture date or a sign-up cut-off.
generatedFrom: src/data/researchStudies.ts NOTICE_ROWS (generated by scripts/build-research.mjs from src/data/graveyard.ts, src/data/changes.ts and ops/research/shutdown-announcements.json, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.name: What was shut down or deprecated
fields.status: dead, dying or deprecated, as the graveyard records it
fields.end: The end date at the source's precision; null where the vendor gives none
fields.endPrecision: day, month or year; null with no end date
fields.endLabel: What happens on the end date, in the vendor's terms
fields.announced: The day the vendor published the notice, where a page read dates it; null otherwise
fields.noticeDays: Whole days from announced to end; null unless both are dates to the day
fields.exclusion: Why noticeDays is null; null when it is computed
fields.note: What the pages read say instead of an announcement date
fields.how: How the page read dates the announcement
fields.announcementUrl: The page that dates the announcement
fields.endUrl: The graveyard's source for the end
fields.endQuote: The graveyard's quote for the end
fields.changesEntries: Titles of changes-tracker entries on the same page and the same date as the end

items.name: Fitbit Web API
items.exclusion: no dated announcement on the pages read
items.note: Google's Google Health API page, read 2026-11-06, gives the end of support (September 30, 2026) and the turn-off (November 2, 2026) but no date for when either was announced.
items.endQuote: The Fitbit Web API and Fitbit OAuth endpoints will be turned off and will no longer function or sync data to or from Fitbit users. Requests to these endpoints will fail and return an HTTP 410 Gone status code.
items.changesEntries: Fitbit Web API turn-off moves to November 2, 2026

items.name: Terra legacy widget session endpoint
items.exclusion: no dated announcement on the pages read
items.note: Terra's widget documentation, read 2026-11-06, gives the planned deprecation date and a 3 September 2026 cut-off for new accounts, but not when the deprecation was announced.
items.endQuote: Existing integrations keep working today, and the legacy endpoint is planned for deprecation on 3 November 2026. Accounts created after 3 September 2026 cannot use it at all.

items.name: Google Fit APIs (Android and REST)
items.exclusion: end date given only as a year
items.note: Google's Fit page, read 2026-11-06, says the APIs will be deprecated in 2026; its May 1, 2024 date is when new sign-ups closed, not an announcement.
items.endQuote: The Google Fit API (including the REST API) will only be supported until the end of 2026. We recommend migrating to the Google Health API for cloud-based integrations or Health Connect for step tracking and mobile-first apps.

items.name: Google Fit Goals API
items.exclusion: end date given only as a year
items.note: Google's migration guide lists it among the features with no replacement and dates the end only to 2026.
items.endQuote: No replacement API available. Manage goal tracking and daily activity targets within your application logic.

items.name: Google Fit Sensors API and BLE API
items.exclusion: end date given only as a year
items.note: Google's migration guide lists both among the features with no direct replacement and dates the end only to 2026.
items.endQuote: The following features don't have a direct API replacement. Use the recommended Android standard APIs:

items.name: Strava Club Activities, Club Members and Club Admins endpoints

items.endQuote: The get running race and list races endpoints will start to return empty values starting October 15th, 2021, and will be removed completely by November 1st, 2021.
